seo.title: Pricing | Setu Technology Plans for Every Business
seo.description: Simple pricing for Setu Dine, Setu Queue and Setu QR Menu. Free tools, free trials, and per-business plans in rupees or dollars. All prices include GST.

hero.headline: Priced per business, not per outlet
hero.subheadline: One plan covers your whole business. Start free, and only pay once the tool is earning its place.

billingNote: All prices are per business account and include GST. Yearly billing is charged once for twelve months.

items.question: Is pricing per outlet or per business?
items.answer: Per business account. One plan covers your whole business, however many outlets or staff logins you run, so growing does not change what you pay.

items.question: Do the prices include GST?
items.answer: Yes. Every price shown is inclusive of GST, so the amount you see is the amount you pay. There is no separate tax added at checkout.

items.question: What happens after the free trial ends?
items.answer: Setu Dine and Setu Queue are free for the first month, and Setu QR Menu is free for the first year. After that you pick monthly or yearly billing.

items.question: Are the calculators and tools free?
items.answer: Yes. Every calculator and tool on the site is free with no signup, and the Browser Based POS is free forever. Only Dine, Queue and QR Menu are paid.
